Subject: Intimation of Q2FY2027 Earnings Call 
 
Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform you that a conference call will be 
held on Wednesday, 4th November, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. IST in respect of financial

You are requested to take the same on your records. 
 
Thanking you.
